thoughts: **Alright, here's the plan, and I'm executing it now.**  I needed to create a JSON array with 60 objects. Each one had to cover a one-second interval, from the very start of the video (00:00:00.000) to the one-minute mark (00:01:00.000).  Each object needed to be structured with "start", "end", and "caption" keys. The timestamps had to be precise, in that "HH:MM:SS.mmm" format.  And most importantly, the captions needed to concisely describe what was happening in each one-second slice. So, I went through the video, frame by frame almost, to capture those moments.
